mapper.sql: p.deleted = 0 AND ((p.initiator_open_id = #{openId} AND p.initiator_visible_flag = 1) OR (p.partner_open_id = #{openId} AND p.partner_visible_flag = 1))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_pair_session p WHERE

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS pair_session_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(v.title, ''), '已删除题型') AS title, v.version_no, CASE WHEN p.pair_status = #{pendingStatus} AND p.expires_at < #{now} THEN #{expiredStatus} ELSE p.pair_status END AS pair_status, p.create_date AS created_at, p.expires_at FROM t_pair_session p LEFT JOIN t_test_version v ON v.id = p.version_id AND v.deleted = 0 WHERE ORDER BY p.create_date DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_pair_session (pair_no, create_request_id, invite_token_hash, version_id, initiator_open_id, initiator_answer_session_id, pair_status, initiator_visible_flag, partner_visible_flag, expires_at, deleted) VALUES (#{pairNo}, #{createRequestId}, #{inviteTokenHash}, #{versionId}, #{initiatorOpenId}, #{initiatorAnswerSessionId}, #{pairStatus}, #{initiatorVisibleFlag}, #{partnerVisibleFlag}, #{expiresAt}, #{deleted})
